subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `agents.defaults` and per-agent hard iteration budget surface, and should that budget cap tool-calling rounds, total tool calls, or both?
rationale: Adding this config surface affects core runtime behavior, provider/harness compatibility, and upgrade expectations; automation should not choose the permanent product semantics while an open candidate PR is already under review.

options.title: Narrow and land the budget candidate
options.body: Review and rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485 or a successor as an opt-in agent-level budget after resolving scope, defaults, and exhaustion behavior.

options.title: Split the budget semantics first
options.body: Keep this issue open but require separate decisions for round caps, total tool-call caps, and timeout-after-first-tool-call before accepting code.

options.title: Decline new hard budgets for now
options.body: Keep loop detection and existing timeouts as the supported guardrails, then close this issue with that product decision and update docs if needed.

recommendation.title: Narrow and land the budget candidate
recommendation.body: Review and rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485 or a successor as an opt-in agent-level budget after resolving scope, defaults, and exhaustion behavior.
